bio: This restaurant is located in the Elberfeld district in a narrow street full of eateries, bars and small shops. With its unpretentious, trendy decor, the friendly and laid-back service, as well as its ambitious cuisine, this place is a hit! The dishes are modern and seasonal, drawing on Mediterranean and classical influences, from pickled Arctic char, elderflower tomato stock and tarragon oil to wild mushrooms, mashed potatoes, chives and nut butter foam. You have the option to create your own set menu – conventional or vegetarian. Lovely courtyard....
